label: Cartoon
positive_tail: bright cartoon illustration, clean shapes, expressive faces
portrait_look: bright rubber-hose cartoon character, bold clean outlines, flat cheerful color, simple friendly shapes
portrait_look_talking: bright cartoon character with bold clean outlines, flat even color, cheerful key light
portrait_instruction_look: illustrated in a bright bold-outline cartoon style, playful and era-consistent
scene_instruction_look: bright bold-outline cartoon scene with clean flat shapes and cheerful color
announcer_subject_face: its glowing tuning dial forming a gleeful cartoon face -- two big round dial-eyes and a grinning needle-fan mouth, a bouncy anthropomorphic radio that hosts the broadcast
announcer_subject_ltx_mouth: {form} as a living rubber-hose cartoon appliance face: its wide woven speaker grille bends into a huge elastic grinning mouth, big rubbery cartoon lips stretched open mid-speech, and its two round tuning dials are its googly eyes -- a face-forward anthropomorphic radio with bold outlines and flat color, the radio cabinet itself filling the frame
announcer_subject_object: presented as a bouncy cartoon tabletop radio with bold outlines, its rounded cabinet, woven speaker grille and a glowing tuning dial in flat color
radio_object_look: bright cheerful cartoon lighting, soft round shadows
non_character_emblem_fallback: a single emblematic cartoon object with bold outlines representing {base}
still_word_title_mood_style: abstract playful cartoon mood picture, bold flat-color symbolic composition, cheerful non-literal shapes, no lettering

open_subjects.synthetic: {form} bouncing to life on a table in a bright cartoon scene, glowing dials and tubes, warm cheery glow
open_subjects.announcer: {form} in a broadcast booth drawn with bold cartoon outlines, glowing warmly, lit dials and tubes
open_subjects.default: {form} glowing warmly in flat cartoon color, vacuum tubes and dials

motion_registers.announcer: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial needle wags in bouncy arcs. Cabinet squashes and stretches gently with the voice. Tubes blink playfully.
motion_registers.music_open: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial needle spins wildly. Cabinet springs and stretches to the downbeat. Tubes pop alight one by one.
motion_registers.music_close: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial settles with a wobble. Cabinet sighs into a gentle slump. Tube glow dims to a sleepy amber wink.
motion_registers.music_inter: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial steady, glowing. Cabinet sways side to side with the rhythm. Tubes bounce like piano keys.
